blocks.prompt: 4 (i) Given the function \(f(x) = \sqrt{x}\). Find the equation of the function after: vertical stretch by factor 2
blocks.explanation:
Yeh \(f(x) = \sqrt{x}\) par ek vertical scaling ka sawal hai.
Diya kya hai? \(f(x) = \sqrt{x}\). Find kya karna hai? Factor 2 se vertical stretch ke baad naya function.
Rule: vertical stretch \(y = af(x)\) hai, yahan \(a = 2\). Poore function ko 2 se multiply karna hai, kyun ke yeh bahar (y par) ki tabdeeli hai.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(f(x) = \sqrt{x}\), \(x \ge 0\).
Maloom karna: factor 2 se vertical stretch ke baad function.
Tareeqa: vertical scaling \(y = af(x)\); \(a > 1\) ho to graph \(a\) guna oopar khinch jata hai. Yeh formula is liye kyun ke stretch output (\(y\)) par hai.

Stretch lagaiye
\[y = 2f(x)\]
\[y = 2\sqrt{x}\]
Kyun: \(f\) ka har output double ho gaya; input \(x\) ko haath nahin lagaya, is liye 2 root ke bahar hai, andar nahin.
Dhyan dein: \(\sqrt{2x}\) likhna ghalat hoga; woh to horizontal tabdeeli hai.

Tasdeeq:
\(\sqrt{x}\) ka point \((4, 2)\) ab \((4, 4)\) ban gaya; aur \(2\sqrt{4} = 4\). Domain \(x \ge 0\) hi raha, kyun ke vertical stretch \(x\) ko nahin badalta.

blocks.prompt: 4 (ii) Given the function \(f(x) = \sqrt{x}\). Find the equation of the function after: horizontal shift 3 units to the right
blocks.explanation:
Yeh \(f(x) = \sqrt{x}\) par ek horizontal shift ka sawal hai.
Diya kya hai? \(f(x) = \sqrt{x}\). Find kya karna hai? 3 units daayen shift ke baad function.
Rule: horizontal shift \(y = f(x - h)\); daayen ka matlab \(h = 3\). Yani \(x\) ki jagah \(x - 3\) likhna hai (andar ki tabdeeli, ulti chalti hai).
steps:
Diya gaya: \(f(x) = \sqrt{x}\).
Maloom karna: 3 units daayen shift ke baad function.
Tareeqa: \(y = f(x - h)\); daayen jane ke liye \(h > 0\), yani \(h = 3\).

\(x\) ki jagah \(x - 3\) rakhiye
\[y = f(x - 3)\]
\[y = \sqrt{x - 3}\]
Kyun: \(x\) ki jagah \(x - h\) rakhne se graph daayen jata hai, halaan ke minus likha hai (Section 1.9 mein wajah dekhi thi).
Dhyan dein: \(\sqrt{x} - 3\) ghalat hai; woh to 3 units neeche shift hai.

Tasdeeq:
Shuruaati point \((0, 0)\) ab \((3, 0)\) par aa gaya: \(\sqrt{3 - 3} = 0\). Domain \(x \ge 3\) ho gaya, kyun ke root ke andar negative nahin aa sakta.

blocks.prompt: 4 (iii) Given the function \(f(x) = \sqrt{x}\). Find the equation of the function after: applying both transformations (i) and (ii).
blocks.explanation:
Yahan dono transformations ek ke baad ek lagani hain: pehle (i), phir (ii).
Diya kya hai? \(f(x) = \sqrt{x}\). Find kya karna hai? Dono tabdeeliyon ke baad aakhri function.
Plan: pehle stretch se \(g(x) = 2\sqrt{x}\), phir \(g\) ko 3 units daayen, yani \(g\) ke har \(x\) ki jagah \(x - 3\).
Har qadam pichle qadam ke nateeje par lagta hai, asal f par nahin.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(f(x) = \sqrt{x}\).
Maloom karna: pehle 2 se vertical stretch aur phir 3 units daayen shift ke baad function.
Tareeqa: (i) lagaiye, nateeje ka naam rakhiye, phir us par (ii) lagaiye. Naam rakhne se pata rehta hai ke agla qadam kis function par lag raha hai.

Qadam 1: 2 se vertical stretch
\[g(x) = 2\sqrt{x}\]
Kyun: yeh part (i) ka jawab hai; ab yahi hamara naya function hai.

Qadam 2: g ko 3 units daayen
\[y = g(x - 3)\]
\[y = 2\sqrt{x - 3}\]
Kyun: shift mojooda function \(g\) par lagi; sirf us ka \(x\) badla, bahar wala 2 apni jagah raha.

Tasdeeq:
\(\sqrt{x}\) ka point \((1, 1)\) stretch ke baad \((1, 2)\) aur shift ke baad \((4, 2)\) ban gaya; aur \(2\sqrt{4 - 3} = 2\). Agar pehle shift aur phir stretch karte to bhi yahi jawab aata, kyun ke ek tabdeeli vertical hai aur doosri horizontal; yeh ek doosre ko nahin chhooti.
